full_details: You rehearsed Love's Labour's Lost at the Cross Keys from nine until eleven. Garnish kept the column beside Costard open and read no total. Kemp asked for another pass at remuneration, and you told him Thursday may add and Monday may not. The watchet gown is still fifty shillings unpaid, and Nick is not in it yet. You took the Muscovites again with Nick and Arthur, changing the favours, and Pope waiting on the Worthies. Phillips left Sam's cuckoo song for tomorrow. At two the company played The Shrew at the Keys. You were at the lodging, at your tables, and you were not in it. At supper Mistress Ansell would not rule The Shrew off one sentence, and she did not reopen the verdict she gave in January.
one_sentence: You rehearsed the comedy at the Cross Keys, stayed home while the company played The Shrew, and named Thursday at two of the clock.
title: Rehearsed the comedy and stayed home from The Shrew
